description: Create a post of any post type. Meta keys are run through sanitize_key (lowercase a-z0-9_-).

content.description: Post content (default empty). Note: the endpoint sanitizes it as plain text, so HTML tags are stripped

meta.description: Post meta key-value pairs, written with update_post_meta

type.description: Post type name (e.g. post, page, product, testimonial)

name: mcp_create_cpt_post
